_comment: English and Mandarin versions of replies that are NOT in a Q&A spreadsheet (the chatbot's built-in "sorry" reply). Spreadsheet answers are translated in their Answer_EN / Answer_ZH columns; room answers come from data/rooms.json (name_en/name_zh, location_en/location_zh).

Maaf, saya hanya membantu menunjukkan lo.en: Sorry, I can only help you find places on campus. Try asking for a room, for example "Where is Admisi?" or "Where is LSC?"
Maaf, saya hanya membantu menunjukkan lo.zh: 抱歉，我只能帮您查找校园内的位置。请试着问一个房间，例如“Admisi 在哪里？”或“LSC 在哪里？”
